briefing: Markets sold off sharply today with NASDAQ down 2.3% and S&P 500 down 1.2%, putting conditions firmly in risk-off territory. No new candidates were screened, so no buys were made. Existing positions are held as-is, with stop-loss and profit-target rules continuing to run automatically in the background.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: 'Risk-off' describes a market mood where investors sell riskier assets like growth stocks and move toward safer holdings or cash. It often happens after bad economic news or rising uncertainty, and tends to hit high-growth tech stocks harder than the broader market, as we saw today with NASDAQ underperforming the S&P 500.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「risk-off」（風險趨避）是指投資者情緒轉趨保守，拋售風險較高的資產（如成長股），轉而持有較安全的資產或現金。這通常發生在壞消息或不確定性上升時，而高成長科技股受到的衝擊往往比大盤更大，正如今日納指跌幅遠超標普500指數所反映的情況。

market_education.summary_en: Broad-based selling hit tech-heavy indexes harder than the broader market today, with NASDAQ falling more than twice as much as the S&P 500. This pattern typically reflects investors rotating out of higher-growth, higher-valuation names during periods of risk aversion. Without specific confirmed headlines available today, the safest read is a general risk-off shift rather than a single catalyst.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤出現全面性拋售，科技股集中的納斯達克指數跌幅遠超標普500指數，顯示投資人在風險趨避情緒升溫時傾向減持高成長、高估值股票。由於今日未有確認的具體新聞標題可供引用，較穩妥的解讀是市場情緒轉向保守，而非單一事件所致。
